questions.q: Where does the Sample Superstore dataset come from?
options: It ships bundled with Tableau Desktop itself — no separate download needed
You must download it from a government open-data portal
It's generated randomly the first time you open Tableau
It only exists inside Tableau Public, not Tableau Desktop
questions.explain: Sample Superstore is a Saved Data Source that comes bundled with Tableau Desktop and appears right on the start page — no download required.

questions.q: What does one row of Sample Superstore represent?
options: A single line item on an order — one product, on one order, shipped to one customer
A single customer's entire lifetime purchase history
A single day of company-wide sales totals
A single store location's monthly summary
questions.explain: Sample Superstore is at order-line-item granularity: each row is one product on one specific order.

questions.q: Which of these is a Measure in Sample Superstore, not a Dimension?
options: Profit
Region
Customer Name
Category
questions.explain: Profit is a numeric, quantitative field — a Measure. Region, Customer Name, and Category are all qualitative Dimensions.

questions.q: Why does this course keep reusing Sample Superstore instead of introducing a new dataset every lesson?
options: So lesson time goes to teaching the new Tableau skill, not re-explaining what each column in a brand-new dataset means
Because Tableau Desktop cannot connect to more than one dataset
Because Sample Superstore is the only dataset Tableau Public supports
Because switching datasets would violate Tableau's license terms
questions.explain: Reusing a familiar dataset means every new feature can be taught on data you already understand, keeping the focus on the Tableau skill itself.

questions.q: Where does this course point you to find additional real datasets for later portfolio work?
options: Tableau's own 'Find Good Data Sets' help page, which lists reliable free sources like government open-data portals and Kaggle
A private dataset repository only available to this course's students
Sample Superstore is the only dataset this course ever uses, including for the portfolio projects
A random web search with no guidance on what makes a dataset usable
questions.explain: Tableau's Find Good Data Sets page is the resource this lesson bookmarks for finding clean, portfolio-ready datasets starting in Chapter 17.
